title: Counter
hubSub: Dossierly speaks for you at the office, and knows your case while it does.
heroBody: Phone flat between you and the official: Polish on top for them, your language below for you. Documents and next steps come up as you talk.
kitLink: No Polish speaker? Try a test official
rehearseSub: A Polish AI official asks what the office will ask about your case, then gives feedback.
talkSub: A voice call about your case, any time.
nothingSub: Conversations at the counter and calls appear here with what was agreed.
phoneSub: When something urgent lands and you haven’t opened the app, Dossierly phones you and explains it.
callFailed: The call could not be placed.
intro: Lay the phone flat between you and the official, this end toward you.
step1: The top half speaks Polish to the official. The bottom half is yours, in {lang}.
step2: When they ask for a document, it opens on their half. Tasks go into your case.
fine: Audio goes through our server to Meta’s speech model and is not stored. Dossierly interprets and guides; it is not a lawyer and files nothing for you.
testHint: Plays a synthetic voice into the real speech pipeline
flipFlatAria: Official half is upside down for a flat phone; tap for upright
flipUprightAria: Official half upright; tap to turn it for a flat phone
coachMeans: What this means for your case
emptyUser: Listening. Speak when you are ready, or let the official start.
